_comment: PLACEHOLDER PRICING. This file belongs to the Economy developer (DEL-05), not to the crop simulation. It exists now only because the GDD requires the crop-selection screen to show seed cost, growth duration and expected payout, and that screen cannot show a price that does not exist. Every number here is a guess and should be replaced with researched figures. Kept separate from crops.json so two developers are not editing the same file.

maize.note: Cheap seed, slow to mature, low value per kilogram. The safe staple.

beans.note: Dearer seed and a smaller harvest, but worth more per kilogram and ready sooner. The riskier, better-paying option.
